MY SAMPLE COOKBOOK

INGREDIENTS (3 SERVINGS)

Smoky Rub (1 Serving)
– 1 Tsp each: Salt, Smoked Paprika, Onion
Powder, Garlic Powder
Roasted Sweet Potatoes
– 600g Sweet Potatoes, cubed
– 1 Serving Smoky Rub
– 1 tsp Olive Oil
Turkey Mince
– 500g (17.6oz) 93% Lean Ground Turkey
– 0.5 Serving Smoky Rub
– 30g (1oz) Cheddar Cheese (or any
reduced fat cheese)
– 10g Butter
(or butter of choice)

Lime Crema
– 120g 0% Greek Yogurt (or yogurt of choice)
– ½ Tsp each Salt, Cumin
– Juice of 1 Whole Lime


INSTRUCTIONS

z S T E P 1
Toss the sweet potatoes with the smoky rub and olive oil, z
then roast at 200°C for 25 minutes.
z S T E P 2
Stir the yogurt, salt, cumin and lime juice together. »»
IMPORTANT COOKING NOTES

» Continue
Chill until needed.
S T E P 3
Melt the butter in a pan and brown the turkey with the rest of the
rub, then top with cheddar
and serve with the potatoes and crema.

z Keep the crema in its own container.

z Reheat the turkey and potatoes only.
